notes: These charts use the days recorded live, 13 November 2026.
The stock list is the index members, with their sectors, that the live recorder follows; no list is carried back into the past.
Look-alikes are stocks of the same sector and size with no link to the catalyst. Every echo figure is linked stocks minus look-alikes.
Error bars are two standard errors either way. Weeks are counted as separate readings; days inside a week are not.
News bursts are counted by trading day, so a Monday's count holds the weekend's stories.

Shuffled maps keep every stock with its number of links, but move each link to another stock. On the main set, shuffled within sectors, a link moves only to a stock of the same sector, so news that hits a whole sector moves those maps too.
